step1_analysis.description: This circuit appears to be a portion of a Decision Feedback Equalizer (DFE) summer or latch, featuring data inputs, clock inputs (CK1, CK2), offset cancellation, and DFE tap inputs (H3_14). However, the provided netlist is severely malformed (likely due to schematic extraction errors), with almost all transistor drains shorted to GND, rendering its intended analog function inoperable.

paper_reference.title: 28Gb/s 560mW Multi-Standard SerDes with SingleStage Analog Front-End and 14-Tap DecisionFeedback Equalizer in 28nm CMOS

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the block.

sky130_expected.calculation: Due to the shorted PMOS transistors (XM2, XM13) with Vsg=1.8V and Vsd=1.8V, the circuit will draw massive short-circuit current. I = 0.5 * up * Cox * (W/L) * (Vsg - |Vth|)^2 = 0.5 * 50u * 10 * (1.8 - 0.42)^2 ≈ 476uA per transistor. Total power will be artificially high due to the shorts.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the short-circuit paths present in the malformed netlist.

peak_transient_current.description: Maximum current drawn from the supply during clock/data transitions.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic switching of CK2 will cause additional short-circuit currents through XM3, XM11, and XM15.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected peak current due to the direct paths to ground in the extracted netlist.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power and transient current of the DFE block. Note: Due to the shorted nature of the netlist, functional AC/Tran metrics (like gain or delay) cannot be meaningfully measured.
step3_testbench.spice:
* DFE Summer/Latch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u

XM1 GND GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 GND GND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 GND CK2 GND VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 GND LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 GND CK2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 GND LABEL_NET_1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 GND LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 GND OFFSET N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 CK2 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 GND DATA GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 GND CK2 GND VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 GND CK1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 GND GND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 GND H3_14 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 GND GND CK2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}

* Voltage Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VOFFSET OFFSET 0 0.9
VH3_14 H3_14 0 0.9

* High-speed Clocks and Data (28Gbps -> ~35ps UI)
VDATA DATA 0 pulse(0 1.8 0 5p 5p 30p 70p)
VCK1 CK1 0 pulse(0 1.8 0 5p 5p 17.5p 35p)
VCK2 CK2 0 pulse(1.8 0 0 5p 5p 17.5p 35p)

.control
* DC Operating Point for Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* Transient Analysis
tran 1p 200p
meas tran peak_current min i(VVDD)
let peak_current_abs = -peak_current
print peak_current_abs

quit
.endc
